sections.title: Deadlines and unfinished work
sections.sql: SELECT number,summary,owner,due_on,days_left,searches_open,reviews_open FROM deadline_desk ORDER BY due_on NULLS FIRST,number

sections.title: Departmental searches
sections.sql: SELECT number,department,owner,scope,due_on FROM search_queue ORDER BY due_on,number

sections.title: Open requests
sections.sql: SELECT department,count(*)::integer AS open_requests,count(*) FILTER(WHERE due_on<current_date)::integer AS overdue FROM requests WHERE state='open' GROUP BY department ORDER BY department

sections.title: Review findings
sections.sql: SELECT number,rule,finding FROM compliance_findings ORDER BY number,rule

sections.title: Documents awaiting review
sections.sql: SELECT number,reference,description,pages FROM review_queue ORDER BY number,reference
